content.comment_body: We have a test jig setup controlled by a [product_name] module, which is working well. The system under test has a networked PC running Windows 10 with application software. We want the PC to signal to the [product_name] module once it has booted and is ready, so the [product_name] can initiate the testing sequence. What is the simplest method to enable this communication—getting the PC to instruct the PLC program to begin testing?
You can use the integrated web server in the [product_name]. It's accessible from the PC's browser.

Is it possible to automate this process, for example using command line tools on the PC like Python or C, so the PC can communicate readiness to the [product_name] automatically at boot without manual intervention?
That might be achievable, but I don't have the details.
Why can't you provide more information? I assumed connecting a PC to a [product_name] module for control would be straightforward and common.
I said, 'That might be achievable, but I can't provide specifics' because I simply don't know the method. It's not that I don't want to help.

On the German section of the forum, a user created a small executable program that allows you to change flag and V-bit statuses using Libnodave. The provided program folder '[product_name]_Updater' includes a screen recording of its use. The executable '[product_name]_Updater.exe' can be auto-started after boot—such as by calling it in autoexec.bat on Windows.
That seems perfect and exactly what we needed—a utility to set a flag in [product_name] and start testing automatically. Thank you.
That sounds like a good solution.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are looking for a straightforward way for a Windows 10 PC to interact programmatically with a [product_name] module, enabling automated test initiation. While web server suggestions provide access, they lack full automation. The discussion highlights the demand for executable tools that enable seamless PC-to-PLC communication on startup, reflecting user expectations for simple integration and automation.
analysis.user_expectations: Users want a simple, automated process for PC-to-[product_name] PLC communication that can trigger test sequences reliably and without manual involvement, preferably using standard scripting or executable solutions on Windows.
